metadata.title: September 9, 2005 - Now Hear This
metadata.author: By Manny Nosowsky / Edited by Mike Shenk

entries.clue: Complaint about a beau that sounds downright optimistic?
It may be grown for your sake
Takes part in an air show
What priggish swimmers abhor that sounds swell to 1930s liberals?
Booze-for-workers supplier that sounds good to tipplers?
Limited furnace work that sounds like major furnace work?
Sea trip for idea men that sounds like any old voyage?
Assumed name taken by Prince Dakkar
Question alarming to young Tell that sounds like one from Juliet?
Hip-hop lyric that sounds like a Jimmy Dorsey song?
Small frog in a big pond?
